topic: Boolean Algebra and De Morgan's Theorems
title: Boolean Algebra and De Morgan's Laws Explained Simply | PUC and ISC
description:
Aarav finds two rules on the fridge. They use different words. Do they mean the same thing? In this animated lesson we learn Boolean algebra, the maths of 1 and 0, and prove De Morgan's two theorems.

We meet the three moves (AND as a dot, OR as a plus, NOT as a bar) and see each main law with switches and a lamp. Then come De Morgan's theorems: break the line, change the sign. On a live breadboard, a NAND gate and two NOT gates feeding an OR gate get the same inputs, the truth table fills row by row and the oscilloscope shows identical output traces. A worked example simplifies a three-gate circuit to a plain wire, followed by the exam trap (forgetting to change the sign), where it is asked, an original JEE Main pattern practice question with a full solution, and a fact card to screenshot.

This is Episode 54 of PUC Electronics, Class 11, Chapter 8: Introduction to Digital Electronics. Boards: Karnataka I PUC Electronics Ch 8 Introduction to Digital Electronics | ISC Class 12 Computer Science: Boolean algebra, De Morgan's laws. Logic gates and Boolean algebra are no longer in the rationalised NCERT/CBSE Physics book.
